derivation:
by
  apply (restrictedNormLimitIso B).inv_comp_eq.mpr
  exact (limit.map_π (restrictedNormDiagramMap (fullInclusion B)) U).symm
explanation: Instantiate projection naturality with the full-inclusion diagram map, then cancel the comparison isomorphism. Its hom and the diagram-map components are definitionally the required maps. The current proof uses this declaration through the two forward-projection wrappers.
